events.title: Lü Bu kills the warlord Dong Zhuo at the palace gate
events.description: Encouraged by Interior Minister Wang Yun, Lü Bu, sworn to Dong Zhuo as a son, struck the fatal blow at the palace gate in Chang'an. Dong's death is seen as a destabilizing event in the collapse of the Eastern Han and a precursor to the Three Kingdoms wars.

events.title: Constantine the Great dies near Nicomedia
events.description: The first Christian Roman emperor died after being baptised on his deathbed. He had founded Constantinople, and the empire was divided among his three sons.
events.html: The first Christian Roman emperor died after being baptised on his deathbed. He had founded Constantinople, and the empire was divided among his three sons.

events.title: The Byzantine navy sacks Damietta in the Nile Delta
events.description: A Byzantine fleet sacked Damietta on the Nile Delta while its garrison was absent, taking captives and weapons intended for the Arab Emirate of Crete. The shocked Abbasid authorities refortified the coasts and strengthened the local fleet.

events.title: Henry Raspe is elected anti-king of Germany
events.description: With papal backing, Henry Raspe, Landgrave of Thuringia, was elected anti-king in opposition to Conrad IV, son of Emperor Frederick II. He defeated Conrad on the Nidda in August but died the next year, leaving no heir.

events.title: Yorkists win the First Battle of St Albans
events.description: Richard, Duke of York, defeated royal forces in the streets of St Albans and took Henry VI into his custody. The clash is usually seen as the opening battle of the Wars of the Roses.
events.html: Richard, Duke of York, defeated royal forces in the streets of St Albans and took Henry VI into his custody. The clash is usually seen as the opening battle of the Wars of the Roses.

events.title: Treaty of Hamburg takes Sweden out of the Seven Years' War
events.description: Sweden made peace with Prussia, restoring the pre-war borders. With Russia's withdrawal that same month, the treaty relieved Frederick the Great of two enemies.
events.html: Sweden made peace with Prussia, restoring the pre-war borders. With Russia's withdrawal that same month, the treaty relieved Frederick the Great of two enemies.

events.title: A strong earthquake shakes Istanbul and the Sea of Marmara
events.description: The magnitude 7.1 earthquake, centred in the eastern Sea of Marmara, struck in the early hours and was felt from Izmit to Rodosto, where a tsunami followed. It was the last major earthquake to strike Istanbul from the North Anatolian Fault.

events.title: Senator Charles Sumner is beaten on the floor of the Senate
events.description: Congressman Preston Brooks attacked the anti-slavery senator with a cane after Sumner's speech against slavery in Kansas. The assault deepened the bitterness between North and South.

events.title: Wright brothers receive their patent for a flying machine
events.description: The US Patent Office granted Orville and Wilbur Wright patent 821,393 for their method of controlling an aircraft. They spent years defending it in the courts.
events.html: The US Patent Office granted Orville and Wilbur Wright patent 821,393 for their method of controlling an aircraft. They spent years defending it in the courts.

events.title: Ceylon becomes the Republic of Sri Lanka
events.description: A new constitution made Ceylon a republic, ending the British monarch's role as head of state, and adopted the name Sri Lanka. The island had become independent in 1948.

song: Zulu Protestant congregations of South Africa; later churches and the anti-apartheid campaign worldwide
A Zulu church song from South Africa whose name means "We are marching". Children's choirs sing it all over the world.
